newTopics.name: Measure Masters
newTopics.blurb: Length, mass and volume — measure it all.

quest.q: A ribbon is 3 m long. How many centimetres is that?
quest.j: 300 cm of ribbon — that's a lot of bows!

quest.q: A bag of rice weighs 2 kg. How many grams is that?
quest.j: That's a heavy bag of rice!

quest.q: A bottle holds 5 l of water. How many millilitres is that?
quest.j: 5 litres — enough for a very thirsty elephant!

quest.q: A rope is 2 m 45 cm long. How many centimetres long is it in all?
quest.j: A 245-cm rope — perfect for skipping!

quest.q: Mei has a 1 m long ribbon. She cuts off 35 cm for a gift. How many centimetres of ribbon are left?
quest.j: 65 cm left — still enough for another bow!

warm.q: How many centimetres are in 4 m?
How many grams are in 3 kg?
How many millilitres are in 2 l?
The pointer on a kitchen scale points halfway between 0 and 1000. What is the mass in grams?
A pencil is 15 cm long. A ruler is 30 cm long. How long are they together?
Ali walks 200 m to school and Ben walks 350 m. How many metres farther does Ben walk than Ali?
3 kg 250 g is how many grams in all?
How many metres are in 700 cm?

fresh.q: A table is 2 m long. How many centimetres is that?
fresh.j: A 200-cm table — room for the whole family!

fresh.q: A watermelon weighs 4 kg. How many grams is that?
A jug holds 3 l of juice. How many millilitres is that?
A measuring jug has marks every 100 ml. The water reaches the 6th mark. How many millilitres of water are there?
fresh.c: Each mark is 100 ml, so 6 × 100 = 600 ml.

fresh.q: A string is 80 cm long. Sam cuts off 25 cm. How many centimetres are left?
fresh.j: 55 cm left — still long enough to tie!

fresh.q: The road from home to the park is 400 m. The road from the park to the library is 250 m. How many metres is the whole trip?
1 m 30 cm is how many centimetres?
How many kilograms are in 5000 g?
How many litres are in 8000 ml?
On a weighing scale, each small mark is 100 g. The pointer is at the 7th mark. What is the mass in grams?
fresh.c: Each mark is 100 g, so 7 × 100 = 700 g.
fresh.j: 700 g — about as heavy as a pineapple!

retry.q: How many centimetres are in 6 m?
A tank holds 4 l of water. How many millilitres is that?
2 kg 500 g is how many grams?
retry.j: 2500 g — that's a big bag of flour!

retry.q: A measuring jug is marked in 100 ml steps. The milk reaches the 4th mark. How many millilitres is that?
retry.c: Each step is 100 ml, so 4 × 100 = 400 ml.

retry.q: A piece of cloth is 90 cm long. Sara cuts off 40 cm. How many centimetres remain?
retry.j: 50 cm left — enough for a headband!

retry.q: Mei cycles 300 m to the shop and 200 m back home. How many metres does she cycle in all?

p4quest.q: A road is 5 km long. How many metres is that?
A container holds 7 l 500 ml of water. How many millilitres is that in all?
p4quest.j: 7500 ml — that's a lot of splashing!

p4quest.q: A parcel weighs 3 kg 750 g. Another parcel weighs 1 kg 250 g. How many grams heavier is the first parcel?
A ribbon 4 m long is cut into 5 equal pieces. How long is each piece in centimetres?
The MRT ride from Station A to Station B is 12 km. From Station B to Station C is 8 km. How many metres is the whole ride?
p4quest.j: 20 km on the MRT — window seat, please!

p4warm.q: How many metres are in 9 km?
Mei buys 2 bags of rice. Each bag weighs 3 kg. How many grams of rice does she buy in all?
A jug holds 4 l of juice. Sara pours in 2 l more. How many millilitres are in the jug now?
A scale has marks every 200 g. The pointer is at the 5th mark. What is the mass in grams?
A rope 3 m long is cut into 6 equal pieces. How long is each piece in centimetres?
Ali walks 1 km 500 m to school. How many metres is that?
A ribbon is 5 m 60 cm long. Mei cuts it into 2 equal pieces. How long is each piece in centimetres?
A 12 m long rope is cut into 3 equal pieces. How long is each piece in centimetres?

p4fresh.q: A bridge is 3 km long. How many metres is that?
A sack of flour weighs 9 kg. How many grams is that?
p4fresh.j: 9000 g of flour — that's a lot of pancakes!

p4fresh.q: A drum holds 6 l 250 ml of oil. How many millilitres is that in all?
A measuring cylinder is marked in 50 ml steps. The water is at the 9th mark. How many millilitres is that?
p4fresh.c: Each step is 50 ml, so 9 × 50 = 450 ml.

p4fresh.q: A 5 m long cloth is cut into 4 equal pieces. How long is each piece in centimetres?
The walk to the market is 800 m. The walk from the market to the library is 700 m. How many metres is the whole walk?
A parcel weighs 4 kg 80 g. The box alone weighs 80 g. How many grams is the parcel without the box?
p4fresh.j: 4000 g of goodies — no box included!

p4fresh.q: A sack weighs 11000 g. Mei takes out 1000 g of flour. How many kilograms are left?
A tank holds 12000 ml of water. Sam pours out 2000 ml. How many litres are left?
On a scale, each big mark is 500 g. The pointer is at the 6th big mark. What is the mass in grams?
p4fresh.c: Each mark is 500 g, so 6 × 500 = 3000 g.

p4retry.q: How many metres are in 7 km?
A bottle holds 2 l 350 ml. How many millilitres in all?
A rope is 6 m 45 cm long. Sam cuts off 45 cm. How many centimetres are left?
p4retry.j: 600 cm left — still a long rope!

p4retry.q: A jug is marked every 250 ml. The juice is at the 4th mark. How many millilitres is that?
p4retry.c: Each mark is 250 ml, so 4 × 250 = 1000 ml.

p4retry.q: A wire 6 m long is cut into 3 equal pieces. How long is each piece in centimetres?
Sara runs 2 km in the morning and 3 km in the evening. How many metres does she run in a day?

newTopics.name: Time Travellers
newTopics.blurb: Telling time and working out durations.

quest.q: How many minutes are in 3 hours?
quest.j: 180 minutes — that's three whole hours of play!

quest.q: A movie starts at 2:00 pm and ends at 4:00 pm. How long is the movie in hours?
quest.j: A 2-hour movie — bring the popcorn!

quest.q: School ends at 1:30 pm. Sara takes 45 minutes to get home. What time does she get home?
quest.j: Home at 2:15 — just in time for a snack!

quest.q: A train arrives at 10:30 am. The ride takes 1 hour 15 minutes. What time did the train leave?
quest.j: The train left at 9:15 — all aboard!

quest.q: Ali starts reading at 11:00 pm and reads for 2 hours. What time does he finish?
quest.c: 11 pm + 1 hour = 12 am, then 1 more hour = 1 am.
quest.j: Reading past midnight — a real bookworm!

warm.q: How many minutes are in 2 hours?
What is 3:00 pm in 24-hour time?
Lunch starts at 12:00 pm and ends at 12:45 pm. How many minutes is lunch?
A bus leaves at 8:00 am. The trip takes 30 minutes. What time does it arrive?
Dinner ends at 7:00 pm. It lasted 1 hour. What time did dinner start?
A show starts at 10:00 pm and ends at 12:00 midnight. How many hours does it last?
Mei reads for 30 minutes, then plays for 30 minutes. How many hours is that in all?
How many minutes are in 1 hour 30 minutes?

fresh.q: How many minutes are in 4 hours?
What is 7:00 pm in 24-hour time?
A class starts at 9:00 am and ends at 10:30 am. How long is the class in minutes?
fresh.c: From 9:00 to 10:30 is 1 hour 30 minutes = 90 minutes.

fresh.q: A film starts at 6:00 pm and lasts 2 hours 15 minutes. What time does it end?
fresh.j: The film ends at 8:15 — credits roll!

fresh.q: A cake is ready at 4:00 pm. It baked for 50 minutes. What time did it go into the oven?
fresh.j: Into the oven at 3:10 — smells yummy!

fresh.q: Ben sleeps at 9:00 pm and wakes at 7:00 am. How many hours does he sleep?
fresh.c: 3 hours to midnight, then 7 more hours = 10 hours.

fresh.q: A train ride takes 45 minutes. Then Ali walks for 15 minutes. How many minutes is the whole trip?
How many hours are in 180 minutes?
What is 11:00 am in 24-hour time?
fresh.c: Morning times stay the same in 24-hour time, so 11:00 am = 11:00.

fresh.q: Swimming starts at 3:15 pm and ends at 4:15 pm. How long is it in minutes?

retry.q: How many minutes are in 5 hours?
A game starts at 5:00 pm and ends at 6:30 pm. How long is it in minutes?
retry.c: From 5:00 to 6:30 is 1 hour 30 minutes = 90 minutes.

retry.q: A lesson starts at 10:00 am and lasts 40 minutes. What time does it end?
A show ends at 9:00 pm. It lasted 2 hours. What time did it start?
retry.j: The show started at 7:00 — front row seats!

retry.q: A night bus leaves at 11:30 pm and the ride takes 1 hour. What time does it arrive?
Sara practises piano for 20 minutes and violin for 40 minutes. How many minutes does she practise in all?

p4quest.q: How many minutes are in 2 hours 45 minutes?
p4quest.c: 2 hours = 120 minutes, then 120 + 45 = 165 minutes.

p4quest.q: A flight leaves at 13:40 and lands at 16:10. How long is the flight in minutes?
p4quest.c: From 13:40 to 16:10 is 2 hours 30 minutes = 150 minutes.

p4quest.q: A concert starts at 19:45 and lasts 2 hours 30 minutes. What time does it end?
p4quest.c: 19:45 + 2 hours 30 minutes = 22:15.

p4quest.q: A bus arrives at 14:20. The journey took 3 hours 40 minutes. What time did it leave?
p4quest.c: 14:20 − 3 hours 40 minutes = 10:40.
p4quest.j: The bus left at 10:40 — all aboard!

p4quest.q: A ferry leaves at 23:20 and the trip takes 2 hours 50 minutes. What time does it arrive?
p4quest.c: 23:20 + 2 hours 50 minutes = 2:10 am the next day.
p4quest.j: Arriving at 2:10 am — the ferry sails through the night!

p4warm.q: How many minutes are in 3 hours 20 minutes?
A film starts at 21:45. What time is that in 12-hour time?
A workshop runs from 10:15 am to 12:45 pm. How many minutes does it last?
A match starts at 15:30 and lasts 1 hour 45 minutes. What time does it end?
Lunch ends at 13:10. It lasted 45 minutes. What time did it start?
Mei goes to bed at 22:30 and wakes at 6:30. How many hours does she sleep?
A journey takes 1 hour 20 minutes by bus and 25 minutes on foot. How many minutes is the whole journey?
How many minutes are in 4 hours 15 minutes?

p4fresh.q: How many minutes are in 6 hours 10 minutes?
p4fresh.c: 6 hours = 360 minutes, then 360 + 10 = 370 minutes.
p4fresh.j: 370 minutes — that's a lot of minutes!

p4fresh.q: A clock shows 00:30. What time is that in 12-hour time?
p4fresh.c: 00:30 is half past midnight, which is 12:30 am.

p4fresh.q: A film starts at 20:05 and ends at 22:35. How long is it in minutes?
p4fresh.c: From 20:05 to 22:35 is 2 hours 30 minutes = 150 minutes.

p4fresh.q: A class starts at 08:50 and lasts 1 hour 25 minutes. What time does it end?
p4fresh.c: 08:50 + 1 hour 25 minutes = 10:15.
p4fresh.j: Class ends at 10:15 — time for recess!

p4fresh.q: A train arrives at 18:05. The ride took 2 hours 35 minutes. What time did it leave?
p4fresh.c: 18:05 − 2 hours 35 minutes = 15:30.
p4fresh.j: The train left at 15:30 — choo choo!

p4fresh.q: A baker starts work at 11:45 pm and works for 4 hours. What time does he finish?
p4fresh.c: 11:45 pm + 15 minutes = 12:00 am, then 3 hours 45 minutes more = 3:45 am.
p4fresh.j: Done at 3:45 am — fresh bread for breakfast!

p4fresh.q: Sara studies for 1 hour 10 minutes, then reads for 50 minutes. How many minutes is that in all?
p4fresh.c: 1 hour 10 minutes = 70 minutes, then 70 + 50 = 120 minutes.

p4fresh.q: How many minutes are in 7 hours 30 minutes?
p4fresh.c: 7 hours = 420 minutes, then 420 + 30 = 450 minutes.
p4fresh.j: 450 minutes — that's a whole school day!

p4fresh.q: A bus leaves at 16:20. What time is that in 12-hour time?
p4fresh.c: 16:20 is after noon, so 16 − 12 = 4, and it is pm.

p4fresh.q: A concert runs from 19:20 to 21:50. How long is it in minutes?
p4fresh.c: From 19:20 to 21:50 is 2 hours 30 minutes = 150 minutes.

p4retry.q: How many minutes are in 5 hours 40 minutes?
A match runs from 16:10 to 18:40. How long is it in minutes?
p4retry.c: From 16:10 to 18:40 is 2 hours 30 minutes = 150 minutes.

p4retry.q: A lesson starts at 11:25 and lasts 55 minutes. What time does it end?
Dinner ends at 20:15. It lasted 1 hour 30 minutes. What time did it start?
A plane leaves at 22:40 and the flight takes 3 hours 30 minutes. What time does it land?
p4retry.c: 22:40 + 3 hours 30 minutes = 2:10 am the next day.
p4retry.j: Landing at 2:10 am — sweet dreams on board!

p4retry.q: A delivery takes 2 hours 15 minutes by van and 45 minutes by boat. How many minutes is the whole trip?
p4retry.j: 180 minutes by van and boat — what a trip!

newTopics.name: Area Adventurers
newTopics.blurb: Area and perimeter — count the squares.

quest.q: A shape is made of 12 squares. Each square is 1 cm by 1 cm. What is the area of the shape?
quest.c: Count the squares: 12 squares of 1 cm² each = 12.
quest.j: 12 squares — count them all!

quest.q: A rectangle is 6 cm long and 4 cm wide. What is its area?
quest.j: 24 square centimetres — nicely covered!

quest.q: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
quest.j: 16 cm around the edge — walk the whole way!

quest.q: A rectilinear shape has sides of 6 cm, 4 cm, 2 cm, 2 cm, 4 cm and 2 cm. What is its perimeter?
quest.j: 20 cm around — add them all up!

quest.q: A square has sides of 5 cm. Its perimeter is 20 cm. What is its area?
quest.c: Area = 5 × 5 = 25. The perimeter (20 cm) is a different thing!
quest.j: 25 square centimetres — area is not perimeter!

warm.q: A shape is made of 9 squares of 1 cm² each. What is its area?
A rectangle is 3 cm long and 2 cm wide. What is its area?
A square has sides of 4 cm. What is its perimeter?
A rectilinear shape has sides 5 cm, 3 cm, 2 cm, 1 cm, 3 cm and 2 cm. What is its perimeter?
A rectangle is 7 cm long and 2 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
A wire is bent into a square with sides of 6 cm. The wire is 24 cm long. It is bent again into a rectangle 8 cm long. How wide is the rectangle?
A shape is made of 15 squares of 1 cm² each. What is its area?
A rectangle is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its area?

fresh.q: A shape is made of 20 squares of 1 cm² each. What is its area?
fresh.c: Count the squares: 20 squares of 1 cm² each = 20.

fresh.q: A rectangle is 9 cm long and 2 cm wide. What is its area?
A rectangle is 7 cm long and 4 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
A rectilinear shape has sides 7 cm, 5 cm, 3 cm, 2 cm, 4 cm and 3 cm. What is its perimeter?
A square has sides of 6 cm. What is its area?
A wire 32 cm long is bent into a rectangle 10 cm long. How wide is the rectangle?
fresh.c: The wire is 32 cm, so 10 + width = 16, and width = 6 cm.

fresh.q: A shape is made of 18 squares of 1 cm² each. What is its area?
fresh.c: Count the squares: 18 squares of 1 cm² each = 18.

fresh.q: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its area?
A square has sides of 7 cm. What is its perimeter?
A wire is bent into a square with sides of 5 cm. The wire is bent again into a rectangle 6 cm long. How wide is the rectangle?
fresh.c: The wire is 4 × 5 = 20 cm, so 6 + width = 10, and width = 4 cm.
fresh.j: 4 cm wide — the wire changed shape!

retry.q: A shape is made of 14 squares of 1 cm² each. What is its area?
retry.c: Count the squares: 14 squares of 1 cm² each = 14.

retry.q: A rectangle is 4 cm long and 6 cm wide. What is its area?
A rectangle is 6 cm long and 2 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
A rectilinear shape has sides 4 cm, 4 cm, 2 cm, 2 cm, 2 cm and 2 cm. What is its perimeter?
A rectangle is 3 cm long and 8 cm wide. What is its area?
A wire 28 cm long is bent into a rectangle 9 cm long. How wide is the rectangle?
retry.c: The wire is 28 cm, so 9 + width = 14, and width = 5 cm.

p4quest.q: A shape is made of 24 squares. Each square is 1 cm by 1 cm. Sara adds 6 more squares. What is the area of the shape now?
p4quest.c: 24 + 6 = 30 squares, and each is 1 cm², so the area is 30 cm².

p4quest.q: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 8 cm wide. Its length is increased by 2 cm. What is the new area?
p4quest.c: The new length is 12 + 2 = 14 cm, so the area is 14 × 8 = 112 cm².

p4quest.q: A rectangle is 15 cm long and 9 cm wide. Its width is increased by 3 cm. What is the new perimeter?
p4quest.c: The new width is 9 + 3 = 12 cm, so the perimeter is 2 × (15 + 12) = 54 cm.

p4quest.q: An L-shaped room has a perimeter of 40 m. Five of its sides are 12 m, 8 m, 4 m, 3 m and 8 m. How long is the sixth side?
p4quest.c: The five known sides add up to 12 + 8 + 4 + 3 + 8 = 35 m, so the last side is 40 − 35 = 5 m.

p4quest.q: A rectangle is 10 cm long and 6 cm wide. Its area is 60 cm². What is its perimeter?
p4quest.c: Perimeter = 2 × (10 + 6) = 32 cm. The area (60) is a different thing!

p4warm.q: A shape is made of 36 squares of 1 cm² each. Sara removes 6 squares. What is its area now?
A rectangle is 11 cm long and 7 cm wide. Its length is doubled. What is the new area?
A square has sides of 9 cm. Its side is increased by 3 cm. What is the new perimeter?
A rectilinear shape has a perimeter of 32 cm. Five of its sides are 10 cm, 6 cm, 4 cm, 2 cm and 6 cm. How long is the sixth side?
A square has sides of 8 cm. Its area is 64 cm². What is its perimeter?
A wire 48 cm long is bent into a square. How long is each side of the square?
A shape is made of 45 squares of 1 cm² each. Sara adds 5 more squares. What is its area now?
A rectangle is 13 cm long and 6 cm wide. Its width is halved. What is the new area?

p4fresh.q: A shape is made of 28 squares of 1 cm² each. Sara removes 8 squares. What is its area now?
p4fresh.c: 28 − 8 = 20 squares left, and each is 1 cm², so the area is 20 cm².

p4fresh.q: A rectangle is 14 cm long and 5 cm wide. Its length is increased by 6 cm. What is the new area?
p4fresh.c: The new length is 14 + 6 = 20 cm, so the area is 20 × 5 = 100 cm².

p4fresh.q: A rectangle is 18 cm long and 6 cm wide. Its length is halved. What is the new perimeter?
p4fresh.c: The new length is 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm, so the perimeter is 2 × (9 + 6) = 30 cm.

p4fresh.q: A rectilinear shape has a perimeter of 32 cm. Five of its sides are 9 cm, 7 cm, 3 cm, 4 cm and 6 cm. How long is the sixth side?
p4fresh.c: The five known sides add up to 9 + 7 + 3 + 4 + 6 = 29 cm, so the last side is 32 − 29 = 3 cm.

p4fresh.q: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 5 cm wide. Its perimeter is 34 cm. What is its area?
p4fresh.c: The area is length × width, so 12 × 5 = 60 cm².
p4fresh.j: 60 cm² — area is length times width!

p4fresh.q: A wire is bent into a rectangle 13 cm long and 9 cm wide. How long is the wire?
p4fresh.c: The perimeter is 2 × (13 + 9) = 44 cm, so the wire is 44 cm long.
p4fresh.j: 44 cm of wire — a perfect fit!

p4fresh.q: A shape is made of 52 squares of 1 cm² each. Sara adds 8 more squares. What is its area now?
p4fresh.c: 52 + 8 = 60 squares, and each is 1 cm², so the area is 60 cm².

p4fresh.q: A rectangle is 16 cm long and 4 cm wide. Its width is doubled. What is the new area?
p4fresh.c: The new width is 4 × 2 = 8 cm, so the area is 16 × 8 = 128 cm².

p4fresh.q: A square has sides of 12 cm. Its side is halved. What is the new perimeter?
p4fresh.c: The new side is 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm, so the perimeter is 4 × 6 = 24 cm.

p4fresh.q: A wire is bent into a square with sides of 11 cm. It is bent again into a rectangle 14 cm long. How wide is the rectangle?
p4fresh.c: The wire is 4 × 11 = 44 cm, so 14 + width = 22, and width = 8 cm.
p4fresh.j: 8 cm wide — the wire changed shape!

p4retry.q: A shape is made of 33 squares of 1 cm² each. Sara removes 3 squares. What is its area now?
p4retry.c: 33 − 3 = 30 squares left, and each is 1 cm², so the area is 30 cm².

p4retry.q: A rectangle is 15 cm long and 7 cm wide. Its width is increased by 3 cm. What is the new area?
p4retry.c: The new width is 7 + 3 = 10 cm, so the area is 15 × 10 = 150 cm².

p4retry.q: A rectangle is 20 cm long and 8 cm wide. Its width is doubled. What is the new perimeter?
p4retry.c: The new width is 8 × 2 = 16 cm, so the perimeter is 2 × (20 + 16) = 72 cm.

p4retry.q: A rectilinear shape has a perimeter of 32 cm. Five of its sides are 11 cm, 5 cm, 4 cm, 3 cm and 7 cm. How long is the sixth side?
p4retry.c: The five known sides add up to 11 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 7 = 30 cm, so the last side is 32 − 30 = 2 cm.

p4retry.q: A square has an area of 100 cm². How long is each side?
p4retry.j: 10 cm each side — a perfect square!

p4retry.q: A wire 60 cm long is bent into a rectangle 18 cm long and 12 cm wide. How much wire is left over?
p4retry.c: The rectangle needs 2 × (18 + 12) = 60 cm of wire, so 60 − 60 = 0 cm is left over.

newTopics.name: Angle Explorers
newTopics.blurb: Right, acute, obtuse — and parallel lines.

quest.q: An angle measures 45 degrees. What type of angle is it?
quest.c: 45° is less than 90°, so it is an acute angle.
quest.j: A tiny 45° angle — sharp and pointy!

quest.q: How many right angles does a rectangle have?
quest.c: A rectangle has 4 corners, and each corner is a right angle.
quest.j: 4 right angles — one at every corner!

quest.q: Railway tracks are an example of which kind of lines?
quest.c: The two rails stay the same distance apart and never meet.
quest.j: Choo choo — parallel tracks!

quest.q: The corner of a book shows which kind of lines?
quest.c: The two edges meet to form a right angle.
quest.j: A book corner — a perfect right angle!

quest.q: Which of these describes two parallel lines?
o: They stay the same distance apart
quest.c: Parallel lines stay the same distance apart and never meet.
quest.j: Same distance apart — forever friends!

warm.q: An angle measures 90 degrees. What type of angle is it?
How many angles does a triangle have?
The two long sides of a ruler are an example of what?
The letter T is made of which kind of lines?
To draw a line parallel to another line, you can use a set square and a ruler. What must stay the same?
Which of these describes two perpendicular lines?
o: They stay the same distance apart
They meet to form a right angle

warm.q: An angle measures 120 degrees. What type of angle is it?
How many right angles does a square have?

fresh.q: Which of these is an acute angle?
fresh.c: 30° is less than 90°, so it is an acute angle.

fresh.q: How many angles does a pentagon have?
fresh.c: A pentagon has 5 sides, so it has 5 angles.

fresh.q: Which of these is a pair of parallel lines?
o: The edges of a door frame that meet at the corner
The opposite sides of a book
The two lines of the letter X
fresh.c: The opposite sides of a book stay the same distance apart.

fresh.q: Which of these is a pair of perpendicular lines?
o: The opposite sides of a table
The adjacent sides of a table
The rails of a train track
The lines of the letter V
fresh.c: The sides that meet at a table corner form a right angle.

fresh.q: Which drawing shows two parallel lines?
o: Two lines that meet at a point
Two lines that cross in the middle
Two lines that run side by side without meeting
Two lines that form a right angle
fresh.c: Parallel lines run side by side and never meet.

fresh.q: To draw a line perpendicular to a given line, what angle must it make with the line?
fresh.c: Perpendicular lines meet at 90°, a right angle.

fresh.q: Sara draws an angle of 95 degrees. Tom draws an angle of 85 degrees. Whose angle is obtuse?
fresh.c: 95° is more than 90°, so Sara's angle is obtuse. Tom's 85° angle is acute.

fresh.q: A triangle has 3 angles. If one is a right angle, how many angles are left?
The lines on a notebook page that run across the page are parallel to each other. What does that mean?
o: They stay the same distance apart
fresh.c: Parallel lines stay the same distance apart.

fresh.q: Which tool is best for drawing a perpendicular line?
fresh.c: A set square has a right angle, perfect for perpendicular lines.
fresh.j: A set square — the right-angle helper!

retry.q: An angle measures 60 degrees. What type of angle is it?
retry.c: 60° is less than 90°, so it is an acute angle.

retry.q: How many angles does a hexagon have?
retry.c: A hexagon has 6 sides, so it has 6 angles.

retry.q: Which of these are parallel lines?
o: The two sides of a ladder
The hands of a clock at 3 o'clock
The lines of the letter A
The edges of a pizza slice
retry.c: The two sides of a ladder stay the same distance apart.

retry.q: Which of these are perpendicular lines?
o: The rails of a train track
The opposite sides of a ruler
The lines of the letter V
retry.c: The corner of a whiteboard forms a right angle.
retry.j: A whiteboard corner — a right angle!

retry.q: When you draw parallel lines, what must be true?
o: They must meet at one point
They must stay the same distance apart
They must be the same length
retry.c: Parallel lines always stay the same distance apart.

retry.q: Two lines meet and form a right angle. What kind of lines are they?
retry.c: Lines that meet at 90° are perpendicular.

p4quest.q: An angle is 45 degrees smaller than a straight angle. What type of angle is it?
p4quest.c: A straight angle is 180°, so 180 − 45 = 135°, which is more than 90°, so it is obtuse.
p4quest.j: Obtuse — wider than a square corner!

p4quest.q: How many right angles are in a rectangle and a square together?
p4quest.c: A rectangle has 4 right angles and a square has 4, so 4 + 4 = 8.

p4quest.q: Which shape has two pairs of parallel sides?
p4quest.c: A rectangle has two pairs of opposite sides that are parallel.
p4quest.j: A rectangle — parallel on both sides!

p4quest.q: A flagpole stands on flat ground. The pole and the ground are which kind of lines?
p4quest.c: The pole stands straight up from the ground, forming a right angle.

p4quest.q: You draw a line, then use a set square to draw a second line that stays 3 cm away from it all along. What have you drawn?
p4quest.c: The second line stays the same distance away, so the lines are parallel.

p4warm.q: Mei draws an angle wider than a square corner but not as wide as a straight line. What type of angle is it?
How many angles does an octagon have?
Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
The sides of a rectangle that meet at a corner are which kind of lines?
To draw a line parallel to a given line through a point, what do you use the set square for?
o: To keep the distance the same

p4warm.q: Which drawing shows perpendicular lines?
o: Two lines that meet at 90 degrees
Two lines that meet at 45 degrees
Two lines that are the same length

p4warm.q: An angle is 1 degree smaller than a right angle. What type of angle is it?
Two squares are placed side by side. How many right angles do they have in all?

p4fresh.q: Which of these is an obtuse angle?
p4fresh.c: 95° is more than 90°, so it is an obtuse angle.

p4fresh.q: A hexagon has 6 angles. How many more angles does it have than a triangle?
p4fresh.c: 6 − 3 = 3 more angles.

p4fresh.q: A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides. How many pairs of parallel sides does a square have?
p4fresh.c: A square has two pairs of opposite sides that are parallel.

p4fresh.q: The hands of a clock at 3 o'clock are which kind of lines?
p4fresh.c: At 3 o'clock the hands form a right angle.
p4fresh.j: 3 o'clock — a right angle on the clock!

p4fresh.q: Which of these is the correct first step to draw a line parallel to line AB?
o: Draw a line that crosses AB
Place a ruler along AB and slide a set square along it
p4fresh.c: Slide the set square along the ruler to keep the distance the same.
p4fresh.j: Slide the set square — parallel coming up!

p4fresh.q: To draw a line perpendicular to AB at a point on AB, which tool helps you make the right angle?
p4fresh.c: A set square has a right angle built in.
p4fresh.j: A set square — the right-angle helper!

p4fresh.q: An angle is 1 degree bigger than a right angle. What type of angle is it?
p4fresh.c: A right angle is 90°, so 90 + 1 = 91°, which is more than 90°, so it is obtuse.
p4fresh.j: Obtuse — just a little wider than a square corner!

p4fresh.q: A triangle and a square are drawn together. How many angles do they have in all?
p4fresh.c: A triangle has 3 angles and a square has 4, so 3 + 4 = 7.

p4fresh.q: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel. How many sides does a parallelogram have?
p4fresh.c: A parallelogram has 4 sides.

p4fresh.q: A ladder leans against a wall. The wall and the ground form a right angle. What kind of lines are the wall and the ground?
p4fresh.c: The wall and the ground meet at 90°.
p4fresh.j: A wall and the ground — perpendicular!

p4retry.q: An angle is 30 degrees smaller than a straight angle. What type of angle is it?
p4retry.c: A straight angle is 180°, so 180 − 30 = 150°, which is more than 90°, so it is obtuse.
p4retry.j: Obtuse — wider than a square corner!

p4retry.q: A pentagon and a triangle together have how many angles?
p4retry.c: A pentagon has 5 angles and a triangle has 3, so 5 + 3 = 8.

p4retry.q: Which of these shapes has parallel sides?
p4retry.c: A rectangle has opposite sides that are parallel.

p4retry.q: The edges of a door that meet at a corner are which kind of lines?
p4retry.c: The edges meet at a right angle.
p4retry.j: A door corner — a right angle!

p4retry.q: Two lines are drawn so that they are always 2 cm apart. What kind of lines are they?
p4retry.c: Lines that stay the same distance apart are parallel.

p4retry.q: Two lines cross and make 4 right angles. What kind of lines are they?
p4retry.c: Lines that cross at 90° are perpendicular.

newTopics.name: Bar Graph Buddies
newTopics.blurb: Reading bar graphs like a detective.

quest.q: The bar graph shows the number of apples sold each day: Monday 10, Tuesday 15, Wednesday 5. How many apples were sold on Tuesday?
quest.j: 15 apples on Tuesday — crunchy!

quest.q: The bar graph has marks every 2. The bar for red pens reaches the 5th mark. How many red pens are there?
quest.j: 10 red pens — ready to write!

quest.q: The graph shows books read: Ali 8, Ben 5. How many more books did Ali read than Ben?
quest.j: 3 more books — Ali is a bookworm!

quest.q: The graph shows boys and girls in each class. Class A has 10 boys and 12 girls. Class B has 8 boys and 9 girls. How many more girls are in Class A than in Class B?
quest.j: 3 more girls in Class A!

quest.q: The graph shows marbles: red 6, blue 4, green 5. How many marbles are there in all?
quest.j: 15 marbles — a whole collection!
